messages.subject: Project Willow — bring-down call tomorrow?
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena — are you free at 9am for the Project Willow bring-down? Need a second pair of hands on the disclosure schedule before we send to Halloran's team.

Actually — ignore me, wrong Elena, meant to send this to Elena in the corporate team. Apologies!

James
